item.title: Prediction is a Muscle - Moka Productions Lab AI+VR+AR
item.description: Prediction is a Muscle: the human mind is a finely tuned instrument, capable of rapid calculations and assessments. It's akin to a muscle, gaining strength through repetitive exercises and experiences. This concept is brilliantly illustrated by my own daily routine as a diver, where split-second decisions can mean the difference between success and failure.
